reply_text:
㊥ Gist: The key and a short usage note are now in `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`. 小象 has its first logged edition, and two more reading jobs are running with different readers.

㊢ Report (the proforma in the instruction files): I appended a section "Reply proforma: mark each paragraph with its intent" to both files. It holds the 23-mark key, a three-line example, and five rules:
- one mark per paragraph;
- a bracketed target after the mark;
- the Gist stays first;
- mark honestly;
- bells, commits and code are not marked.

`/home/joe/code` is not a git repository, so there is no commit for those two files.

㊟ Qualify (whether other agents pick it up): Sessions read those files at start, so seats already running will not see it until they restart or compact. A way to measure uptake is to count replies that begin with ㊥ in tomorrow's transcripts.

㊢ Report (小象 editions): `scripts/xiaoxiang_editions.py` (commit d8fad3de) trains and scores 小象 on every published reading, live and batch. Each run appends a row to `storage/operator-turns/xiaoxiang-editions.jsonl`. `run` makes an edition and `show` prints the history. Edition 1:

| Turns | Fragments | Accuracy | Macro F1 | Majority baseline | Segment F1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3,630 | 10,551 | 0.371 | 0.221 | 0.151 | 0.779 |

- **Best labels:** approve 0.61, propose 0.45, report 0.42, ask-action 0.41.
- **Worst labels:** qualify 0.07, extend 0.05, prioritize 0.04, redirect 0.03.
- **Left out:** 3,626 fragments with off-list labels from the older batches. They are counted and not mapped, since a mapping is a labelling decision you should see first.

㊢ Report (reading jobs, both parked with 55-minute deadlines):

| Job | Reader | Job id | Park |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chunk 1 fix-up: reread the nine title-only rejections, add the missing searches and candidates | zai-2 | `invoke-1790785129301-29223-5de3366c` | `park-06e48876-e67d-45f2-be54-d44a4300128c` |
| Chunk 2: the next ten turns of 1 August | 象-sonnet | `invoke-1790785132124-29224-a1757b80` | `park-e814cd52-0f49-49ad-b3b5-62b3ad8efa3a` |

The Kimi seats were all busy, so the second reader is Sonnet. The checker now fails any rejection reason that mentions a title and flags a chunk with no citations. With the stricter check, chunk 1 has 16 problems.

㊭ Propose (the rhythm from here): After each chunk passes its check, I run an edition, so the history file shows accuracy against turns read and readers used. When both of these jobs pass, I build the loop that does this unattended, rotating Zai, Kimi and Sonnet, with one turn in ten read twice.

㊟ Qualify (what editions will show): On the present model, the learning curve suggests about three points of accuracy per doubling of data. If several editions in a row stay flat, that is the signal to change the classifier and not the tagging.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text:
Propose (running the backfill with mixed readers):
1. A plain loop that sends ten turns a job, runs the mechanical check on each chunk, and only then sends the next.
2. Seats rotate between Zai, Kimi and 象-sonnet, with the reader recorded on every reading, as it already is.
3. One turn in ten goes to two different readers. That gives a measured agreement rate between readers, which tells 小象's training how noisy the labels are.
4. The closed label list is enforced at publish time, so new readings do not repeat the 634-label spread of the older batches.

- Shall I build that loop once chunk 1 passes its check? At three minutes a record, the 9,300 remaining turns are about 470 seat-hours, so several seats for some days.
- Is the mapping above acceptable as a first version, or would you rather choose the characters yourself?
